subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: How learners can help at home, at school and in the community

show.line: I have helping hands! I can help at home, at school and in my community.

rounds.prompt: How can you help at school?
rounds.praise: Pick up litter! Keep school clean.

rounds.prompt: How can you help at home?
Tell me one way you help at home.

rounds.story: Gogo carries a heavy bag of mielie meal. Nomsa runs to help her. What does Nomsa do?
rounds.praise: She helps carry it! Kind Nomsa.

rounds.prompt: A friend drops her crayons. What do you do?

hints: Helping makes things easier for someone.
Look for someone who needs a hand.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will help at school.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I throw my paper on the floor!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Paper goes in the bin.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Paper in the bin. That is helping!

parent_line: Can say ways to help at home, at school and in the community.
